description: WRITES. Sets or clears the stop-loss and take-profit on an open position without trading. The ONLY way to exit at a price rather than at the market. Brackets settle against daily closes when get_paper_account is read.

stop_loss.description: Exit level below the current mark, per unit in the instrument's currency. Omit to clear this leg.

symbol.description: Symbol of an OPEN position, exactly as get_paper_account lists it, e.g. 'AAPL' or '/HG'.

take_profit.description: Exit level above the current mark, per unit in the instrument's currency. Omit to clear this leg.

name: set_paper_bracket
